weight.description: Signed linear exposure / positive portfolio equity, in a common currency.

volatility_contribution.description: Euler component; may be negative for a hedge.

parameter_credible_interval.description: Equal-tail credible interval for the latent Bernoulli parameter, not the next label.

probability.description: Posterior predictive mean for a single exchangeable Bernoulli event.

ecdf.description: [observed value, fraction <= value], with ties collapsed.

available_at_ms.description: All parameters and data in this task were available at this time.

returns.description: Simple total returns in asset order; common currency and period.

covariance_matrix.description: Row/column order x,y. OLS is y = intercept + slope*x.

residuals.description: Full fit: one residual per input; rolling fit: only last residual.

rows.description: First value is the target for regressions, all columns are features for PCA.

series.description: BH and Bonferroni adjusted p-values in original input order, or CSCV logits.

oneOf.description: Points contain period excess returns, without annualization.
Points contain loss_1 - loss_2; positive means model 2 is better.
Aligned period scores/returns; columns are candidates, higher is better.
Aligned benchmark loss minus candidate loss; positive is better.

Scalar.description: Unavailable and mathematically undefined values never masquerade as zero.

shocks.description: Full vector of price shocks in asset order. No inferred missing shocks.

sharpe_mean.description: Mean and sample standard deviation of unannualized trial Sharpe ratios.

forecasts.description: Conditional levels at horizons 1..steps after the last supplied observation.

lagged_levels.description: Oldest to newest; sufficient starting history for this fitted model.
